title: Salon Management System
summary: MERN stack salon operations: bookings, e-commerce, inventory, staff, customers, billing, and analytics.
overview: A comprehensive MERN stack application for managing salon operations including bookings, e-commerce, inventory, staff management, and customer relations. The codebase is organized as a monorepo with a Vite + React client, Express API server, shared utilities, documentation, and helper scripts. Real-time features use Socket.IO; payments use Stripe; media uses Cloudinary; transactional email uses Nodemailer and SMS uses Twilio.
challenge: Salons juggle bookings, retail, staff rotas, and stock in separate tools with no single source of truth.
solution: A unified MERN application with Redux Toolkit on the client, REST + Socket.IO on the server, MongoDB for persistence, and integrations for payments, media, email, and SMS.
features: Booking system — multi-step flow with service selection, beautician assignment, and time slots
E-commerce — product catalog, cart, and checkout
Chat and chatbot — real-time messaging with AI-assisted bot
Staff management — beautician profiles, schedules, and performance tracking
Inventory management — stock levels, alerts, and supplier tracking
Billing and invoicing — invoices and payment processing
Analytics and reports — dashboards and operational reporting
Settings — configurable business and app settings

title: BookingLK
summary: A full-stack hotel booking platform for discovering, comparing and booking accommodation across Sri Lanka.
overview: BookingLK is a modern full-stack hotel booking platform designed for travelers to discover, compare and book accommodations across Sri Lanka. The platform focuses on a smooth search experience, detailed hotel information, responsive design and a scalable booking architecture.

challenges.challenge: Designing a booking flow that remains simple while supporting multiple booking states.
challenges.solution: Separated frontend UI, API and database responsibilities.

challenges.challenge: Handling hotel, room, availability and booking relationships.
challenges.solution: Designed reusable components for hotels, rooms and booking interfaces.

challenges.challenge: Building a responsive interface that works consistently across desktop and mobile devices.
challenges.solution: Used responsive Tailwind layouts and dedicated mobile behavior.

challenges.challenge: Keeping animations smooth without negatively affecting usability.
challenges.solution: Used Framer Motion for controlled and performant UI transitions.

challenges.challenge: Designing authentication and API access in a secure and maintainable way.
challenges.solution: Implemented server-side validation, protected API routes and secure authentication patterns.

security: Input validation for authentication and booking data
Protected API routes for sensitive operations
Database access handled through server-side APIs
Email receipt with full booking details after a successful booking
API validation and error handling for malformed requests
Email OTP verification for registration and password changes
outcome: Created a scalable hotel-booking foundation with a premium user experience and a structure that can be extended with payments, hotel-owner dashboards, notifications, security monitoring and recommendation systems.
role: Designed and developed the application architecture, frontend interface, API integration, database structure, security architecture and responsive user experience.

title: Cooroonduwatte Tea Factory Management System
summary: A full-stack web app that digitizes a tea factory’s collection areas, suppliers, daily tea weights and operational statistics.
overview: Cooroonduwatte Tea Factory Management System is a full-stack web application developed to digitize and simplify the day-to-day operations of a tea factory. Administrators can manage collection areas, register and update suppliers, record daily tea weights, track factory scale measurements, and monitor differences between collected and factory-recorded weights. A dashboard provides an overview of daily collection performance, area-wise statistics, collection totals and weight information, on both desktop and mobile devices.
challenge: Tea collection records were kept manually across many areas and suppliers, making it hard to keep data accurate and to see daily factory operations at a glance.
solution: A centralized digital platform that replaces manual record management — improving data accuracy, reducing manual work, simplifying collection tracking and giving better visibility into daily operations.
features: Area management with automatic Area ID generation
Supplier management with full CRUD operations
Multiple supplier registration for a selected area
Daily and area-wise tea collection management
Date-based and area-based filtering and analysis
REST-style backend APIs with MongoDB storage
security: Environment variables for database credentials and JWT secrets
Separation of frontend UI and backend API logic
outcome: Replaced manual tea factory record management with a centralized system, ready to be extended with payments, advanced reports, user roles and permissions, automated backups, notifications and financial management.

title: Hotel Check-in Data Scraper
summary: An educational multi-source hotel check-in scraper with a Sri Lanka hotel analytics dashboard.
overview: A complete learning project that teaches web scraping architecture from beginner to production: modular scrapers for Booking.com, Agoda, Expedia, SLTDA and data.gov.lk; parsers and storage layers; rate limiting, retries and structured logging; plus an analytics surface for hotel check-in and occupancy insights. Designed for educational use with ethical scraping practices — robots.txt respect, rate limits, and no CAPTCHA bypass.
note: Educational use only. The scrapers respect robots.txt, site terms and rate limits (about one request every 3–5 seconds), use a descriptive User-Agent and stop if blocked by a CAPTCHA. Government sources (SLTDA, data.gov.lk) are public; scraped data is not republished or used commercially.
challenge: Learning production-grade scraping needs a realistic domain: multi-source hotel check-in data with rate limits, brittle selectors and analytics — not a toy single-file script.
solution: A layered Python system with abstract scrapers, parsers and storage, config-driven selectors, ethical rate limiting, tests, and a hosted analytics UI for Sri Lanka hotel insights.
features: Multi-source scrapers — Booking, Agoda, Expedia, SLTDA and data.gov.lk
Modular pipeline — CLI → scrapers → parsers → CSV/JSON/DB storage
Rate limiting, proxy/UA rotation, and retry with backoff
Pydantic data models for hotel check-in records
Unit, integration, selector health and data-quality tests
Analytics dashboard for check-ins and occupancy insights
